Seen from behind, a cowboy shot and a shallow depth of field.

recipes.title: Greenhouse morning
recipes.positive: An elderly botanist in a linen apron tends to a row of seedlings with a brass watering can. Inside a Victorian glass greenhouse crowded with ferns, condensation beading on the panes. Soft early-morning sun falls through the glass in visible shafts. Shot on 35mm film with the warm colours of Kodak Portra.
